title: Stanford Clock Tower

buildingCutout.basis: Estimated extent of the freestanding shaft and two attached pergola arms, anchored to the campus intersection.

terrainReference.basis: Original source height on the intersection side of the tower steps.

mapIdentity.provider: USGS and USDA public-domain NAIP map, campus grid from OpenStreetMap, and Stanford’s visitor map. The tower does not have its own mapped OSM outline.
mapIdentity.scope: The public-domain USGS and USDA aerial map and Stanford’s campus locator establish the site. The measured bearing of Escondido Mall sets the orientation. The published February 2009 exterior and the roof plan constrain the rectangular shaft and pergola registration.

note: One exact creator-released exterior photograph establishes the three terrace steps, low glazed display, recessed clock panels, actual belfry voids, flat cap and paired colonnades. Heights, concealed sides and the bell array are interpreted from visible proportions and Stanford’s description.
